stages.title: Foundations
stages.milestone: Create, import, inspect, and explain arrays independently.

stages.title: Core array skills
stages.milestone: Solve array selection, manipulation, dtype, ufunc, and broadcasting tasks.

stages.title: Numerical analysis
stages.milestone: Complete a statistical analysis or numerical-method project.

stages.title: Specialized data and I/O
stages.milestone: Read, validate, transform, and export a small data file.

stages.title: Professional development
stages.milestone: Deliver a tested, documented numerical-analysis workflow.

explicit_dependencies.reason: Broadcasting depends on array shapes/dimensions and element-wise operations.
Boolean indexing depends on indexing fundamentals, comparisons, and Boolean arrays.
Advanced indexing follows basic indexing and slicing.
Views/copies are easier to understand after slicing and mutability.
Type promotion builds on dtypes and arithmetic.
Linear algebra depends on shapes and vector/matrix multiplication; instructors may teach the overview before the detailed operation.
Monte Carlo work depends on generators and statistical summaries.
FFT concepts require sampled signals and awareness of numerical precision.
Large-array optimization depends on memory sharing and performance fundamentals.
C API work depends on ndarray metadata, dtypes, and memory allocation.
Production numerical tests use reusable functions and error-handling discipline.

dependency_note: A few dependency pointers intentionally reference a later-numbered topic because the PDF's suggested prerequisite list is cross-cutting rather than strictly linear. Use these as prerequisite warnings/related links, not as a reason to hide the PDF's numbered sequence.
